newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Reef Casino says two directors resign.
newsitem.headline: Reef Casino says two directors resign.

text.p: Casino operator Reef Casino Trust said on Thursday that directors John Morris and Sir Sydney Williams have resigned from the board of Reef Corporate Services Ltd, manager of Reef Casino Trust.
The resignation of the two directors follows the exit last week of Reef Casino Trust chairman John Coates, who is also president of the Australian Olympic Committee (AOC).

Reef Casino is currently seeking additional funds following the withdrawal last year of a A$15 million external working capital facility used to fund high-rolling gambler visits to the Reef Casino at Cairns in northern Queensland.
At 3.00 p.m. (0500 GMT), Reef Trust units were 0.5 cents up at 15.5 cents.
Reef Casino were unavailable to comment on the replacements for Morris and Williams.
